title: unbeatabletwtcord painting fix
description: Fixes transparent painting textures for custom shaders
body:
A seperate pack that makes the paintings opaque for when shaders break it

Make sure to put it higher in the resource pack order to override the paintings

![instructions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96a86e157f2cf10a2e3d3d108c39a8d794294ccc.png)
